name: jev
description: Routes skill selection and post-turn code judgment through TypeSafe Jev, a structured decision model. Works with the TypeSafe API or with OpenRouter. Advisory only, never blocks.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which Jev endpoint to use: typesafe, openrouter, or auto to pick whichever key is present.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key from console.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to use the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable, or run /jev:setup.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key from openrouter.ai. Leave empty to use the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable, or run /jev:setup.

route_enabled.title: Suggest a skill for each prompt
route_enabled.description: Ask Jev which installed skill fits the prompt and inject the suggestion as context.

judge_enabled.title: Judge each turn
judge_enabled.description: After a turn that changed files or ran commands, ask Jev about unverified completion claims, missing tests, and risk. The verdict is shown at the start of the next turn.

route_min_confidence.title: Minimum routing confidence
route_min_confidence.description: Suppress skill suggestions below this confidence.

include_agents.title: Also suggest subagents
include_agents.description: Include installed subagents as routing candidates.

route_exclude.title: Excluded namespaces
route_exclude.description: Comma-separated skill/plugin name prefixes to keep out of routing, for example: ecc:,vercel:

send_diff.title: Send the diff when judging
send_diff.description: Include the git diff of changed files in the judgment request. Turn off to send only file paths and line counts.

timeout_ms.title: Per-request timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long a single Jev call may take inside a hook.
